name: jarvis-desktop
description: Jarvis for Mac: menu bar assistant with always-on listening, open actions, screen look and take control.
author: Jarvis

extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Jarvis listens for its wake phrase ("hey Jarvis") and for what you ask after it. Speech is turned into text on this Mac.
extendInfo.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Jarvis turns what you say into text on this Mac, so it can hear its wake phrase and your questions.
extendInfo.NSAppleEventsUsageDescription: Jarvis does not control other apps with scripts. This is only shown if macOS asks.
